weapons.name: Deepworks Goliath .50
weapons.description: Heart of the Iron Colossus. A squared Deepworks siege receiver and long shrouded barrel drive oversized linked rounds with a deliberate, punishing cadence.

reload.transferRule: One missing loaded round consumes one matching linked-round item at completion. Cancelled reload transfers none. The animation swaps the feed box; inventory ammunition items are individual rounds.

tradeoffs: A large box sustains fire between long reloads
Wide spread, low aimed movement and low magnification limit mobile precision
Signature Q shares the global twelve-second Legendary lock; ordinary armor and native NPC control immunities remain active

ammunition.name: Goliath .50 Linked Rounds
ammunition.description: Individual linked rounds dedicated to Deepworks Goliath .50. One item loads one round. F swaps the feed box and draws the missing rounds from matching inventory stacks; this ammunition item is not a whole box.

balance.damageAccounting: Native single-projectile hit assets use the total body/head values once; receiver/ammo fractions are design accounting only.
balance.nativeProcCaveat: One native projectile launch per paid round and one claimed damaging impact on contact. High magazine capacity extends native per-hit class/enchantment procs; the gun adds no extra proc per round.

weapons.progressionNote: Three endgame seal fragments are guaranteed from the Hollow Warden, Luminian Sentinel and Seal Herald; the recipe also consumes repeatable Gobliterator cores. No existing gun is consumed. Ammunition keeps the prior affordable linked-round ingredient costs and batch size.

ability.name: Colossus Breaker
ability.description: Hold Q for 0.75s to commit one focused 104/156 body/head shot and stagger eligible NPCs for 0.75s. Freeze immunity and enraged interrupt immunity prevent the stagger. The shot commits two loaded rounds, shares the twelve-second Legendary lock and prevents firing for 1.25s after commitment. Releasing early cancels without spending rounds or starting the special cooldown.

weapons.signatureRole: High direct alpha and a charged single-target interrupt; slower rate and aim movement reward deliberate positioning.
weapons.cadenceSource: Measured interval between reports in the selected recording

ability.name: Suppressor's Brand
ability.description: Press Q for one focused 28/40 body/head shot that visibly marks NPCs for 10s and slows eligible NPCs by 35% for 4s. Slow-immune NPCs retain only the visual mark. The shot commits two loaded rounds, shares the twelve-second Legendary lock and prevents firing for 1s after commitment.

designRules: The two existing heavy weapon IDs become level80 Tier5 Legendaries. Other57 weapons keep their stats, recipes and mechanics; separately authorized visual muzzle flashes are handled by the release overlay.

Every gun uses its existing unique matching individual linked rounds. One paid primary shot consumes one round and launches one projectile; the box-swap animation does not make one ammunition item a whole box.
Hard material-only receiver recipes consume three guaranteed endgame seal fragments plus repeatable Gobliterator cores and high-tier materials. No existing or enchanted gun is consumed.
Ammo ingredients, output50/100, MaxStack100 and priorTier4/3 ammo crafting access remain unchanged; post-craft upkeep stays affordable.
Cycle=.18+.01*relativeRoundWeight remains unchanged. Siege begins at16 without an upper cap; rating30/12 means equivalent discharge load, not grams or heat.
F/Use box reload preserves world interaction precedence, late transfer and cancellation. H class abilities remain available. Capacities50/100, cycles.48/.30, reload8/6 and handling stay unchanged.

Goliath ColossusBreaker is one charged focused native projectile with an immunity-respecting NPC stagger. SAW SuppressorsBrand is one focused native projectile with visual NPC mark and immunity-respecting slow. Both cost two loaded rounds and share the existing12s Legendary lock.

No area damage, armor bypass, homing, mark damage amplification or guaranteed boss control is introduced. New Qs use existing native effects and firing/charge sounds; all prior audio waves and native events remain unchanged.
The existing automatic-family traveled-path falloff stays0/20=100%,140=35%, with nominal travel limits120/95.
